objective: Reject a malformed remote-activity ledger record instead of silently overwriting it in EngineOwnedRemoteActivityBroker.enqueue.
constraints: Absence and decode failure must stay distinguishable.
A malformed record must never be silently overwritten; surface a typed error and a diagnostic instead.
The activity attempt must fail visibly with PersistedDataCorruptError.
completedWork: Showed decodeRemoteTaskRecord collapses no existing record and an undecodable record into the same null.
validatedFacts: The idempotent-replay guard and commitTaskLedgerTransition both treat current === null as license to create.

knownFailures.summary: A malformed existing ledger record is indistinguishable from no record, so a replayed enqueue silently overwrites it.

nextRequestedAction: Add a private readExistingOrThrowIfMalformed that distinguishes absence from decode failure, logs a diagnostic, and throws PersistedDataCorruptError.
